title: Watch the turning point between two breaths
caption:
The breath going in and the breath going out are not two. They are one circle, and somewhere inside it turns.

Technique 2 of 112. Like a car passing through neutral gear, the breath passes through a turning point. There you are neither body nor mind. You simply are.

Save this and try it with your next ten breaths.

Technique and sutra from Osho, The Book of Secrets.

.
